description: This file defines the RomTree class, a custom Swing JTree component used in the RomRaider application for navigating and interacting with ROM and related data structures within a graphical user interface.

classes.name: RomTree
classes.description: A custom JTree component tailored for the RomRaider application, supporting specialized rendering, node interactions (clicks, expand/collapse), and key bindings to facilitate navigation and operations within the UI.

methods.name: RomTree
methods.description: Constructor initializing the tree with a root node, setting visual styles, and binding key actions for user interactions.

methods.name: getEditor
methods.description: Returns the current ECUEditor instance used for editing ECU configurations.

methods.name: mouseClicked
methods.description: Handles mouse clicks on tree nodes, expanding/collapsing nodes or opening tables based on user interaction and click count.

methods.name: showTable
methods.description: Displays the table associated with a selected TreeNode if applicable.

methods.name: setLastSelectedRom
methods.description: Updates the editor with the last selected ROM node and refreshes the UI.

methods.name: mousePressed
methods.description: Placeholder for mouse press events; no implementation.

methods.name: mouseReleased
methods.description: Placeholder for mouse release events; no implementation.

methods.name: mouseEntered
methods.description: Placeholder for mouse enter events; no implementation.

methods.name: mouseExited
methods.description: Placeholder for mouse exit events; no implementation.
